sets.relationshipLabel: parent bird and the offspring that belongs to it
sets.explanation: Each pair names a parent bird alongside the special word for its young — swan/cygnet and goose/gosling.

sets.relationshipLabel: broad bird category and a specific kind within it
sets.explanation: Raptor and songbird are umbrella categories, and eagle and sparrow are the familiar species living inside each one.

sets.relationshipLabel: preliminary stage and the larger reproductive activity it leads into
sets.explanation: Courtship sets up mating, and nest-building sets up breeding — each first pair is the ritual that opens the door to the second.

sets.relationshipLabel: two facing moments across one span of bird life
sets.explanation: Hatch and fledge bookend a chick's growth, while depart and return bookend a migration — both pairs mark the opening and closing moment of the same journey.

glossary.definition: A fluffy young water bird, pale gray or white, still too small to fly on its own.
